claim: His opponent wrote the bill (A8560-A) to transfer the Setauket–Port Jefferson Station Greenway to the state DOT
finding: The DOT already owned the greenway. A8560 directed DOT to grant the MTA an easement over part of it for a possible rail yard, and the governor vetoed it. Kassay's follow-up bill (A10341/S10161), which permanently protects the trail, was signed in July 2026.
